name: camayoc_wf_runs_in_window
description: workflow-and-archive Q1: the runs of one workflow definition in one time window, with each run's current state. Window-scoped by an explicit FROM because that is what a window IS — the graph is quipu's unit of pack, attach, label and authority, and a query that forgot the FROM would answer across every month at once. currentState is the derived projection, not the truth; the transitions are the truth (Q2, Q3).
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?run ?label ?state ?startedAt FROM <{window}> WHERE { ?run a aegis:WorkflowRun ; aegis:runOf <{definition}> ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:currentState ?state . OPTIONAL { ?run aegis:createdAt ?startedAt } } ORDER BY ?startedAt
